name_reason: '_40' is the dispatch idx 0x40 (entry @ 0x51C91), a real domain ID, not address residue. Descriptor corrected from '__unref_dyn_turn_event' to '__ch27_mech_defeat_seq': the slot is LIVE, reached via the ch27 kill-drop path -- ch27 char_spawn_records[8..10] = the mech squad (機甲隊長, enemy_data 48, char_id 0x74, lv32, x3) each carry pickup_kind=2 param=0x40, so each mech's death dispatches consequence[0x40]. The prior '_dyn_turn_event' descriptor was also imprecise (this handler does not schedule turn events; it is a 2-stage kill-triggered dispatcher). The new name captures both the chapter and the mechanism (the mech-defeat staged sequence). The earlier 'unref' verdict only scanned turn-event/tile-step hooks and missed the kill-drop path.
stage2_review: renamed -- live via ch27 kill-drop (records[8..10] mech squad enemy_data 48 pickup_kind=2 param=0x40); '_unref_dyn_turn_event' -> '_ch27_mech_defeat_seq'.
purpose: Chapter 27 mech-defeat staged sequence (dispatch idx 0x40, reached via the ch27 kill-drop path when a mech-squad unit records[8..10] enemy_data 48, pickup_kind=2 param=0x40, falls); a 2-stage state-machine dispatcher that, on its stage counter, plays a dialog+portrait cutscene (悠妮's memory awakening) or a dialog+mass-kill (clear the mech squad), then advances the stage byte.
logic_summary: Reads stage = (zero-extended byte) tile_event_consumed_flags[0x10]. If stage==1: fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=1, ...) then three fd2_cinematic_chapter_portrait_dump_with_white_flash calls at tiles/ids (9,0x2C,3),(0,9,4),(0x11,9,5), then data_fd2_battle_anim_phase=1. Else if stage==2: fd2_display_dialog_scene(current_chapter_text, page=2, ...) then fd2_kill_runtime_chars_from_index_to_end(0x10) (kills runtime char slots 0x10..end). For any other stage (0 or 3+) the dispatch body is skipped. In all cases the stage byte is then incremented by 1 (8-bit INC) so consecutive calls dispatch in order. In the binary the unconditional advance+return is a Class-3 shared tail at 0x35992 (MOV EAX,[flags_ptr]; INC byte[EAX+0x10]; RET) which this function's own non-stage-1/2 exits JMP to and which fd2_chapter_event_handler_4a also tail-borrows; the source's if/else-if + unconditional increment is functionally exact.
